lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the hallways where the plaster starts to weep,
Secrets in the floorboards are the promises they keep.
Every shadow stretches like a finger on the wall,
Waiting for the ceiling and the rafters just to fall.
The architecture breathes in and exhales out a sigh,
Watching every human movement with a cold and stony eye.
A labyrinth of timber and of mortar laid in stone,
Where the heavy weight of history sits upon a hollow throne.
[Chorus]
The house is waking, the walls are tight,
Folding in the shadows in the middle of the night.
A symphony of timber, a choir of bone,
The living are prisoners where the ghosts have grown.
[Verse]
Twisted rafters arching like the ribs of ancient whales,
Every crooked doorway tells a thousand unspoken tales.
The hallway stretches longer as the floorboards start to groan,
A kingdom made of timber where the seeds of fear are sown.
Brick by heavy brick, the fortress starts to sway,
Turning every golden hour into a shade of gray.
The rafters are the skeleton, the windows are the eyes,
Watching as the ceiling falls and the foundation cries.
[Chorus]
The house is waking, the walls are tight,
Folding in the shadows in the middle of the night.
A symphony of timber, a choir of bone,
The living are prisoners where the ghosts have grown.
[Bridge]
The foundation is trembling, the joists are in pain,
Waiting for the ceiling to collapse in the rain.
[Chorus]
The house is waking, the walls are tight,
Folding in the shadows in the middle of the night.
A symphony of timber, a choir of bone,
The living are prisoners where the ghosts have grown.
[Outro]
